integrity: The iteration matrix is reconstructed directly from the source's y-then-x implicit update. Necessary-and-sufficient Jury conditions give the stability frontier, the discriminant gives the root-collision point, and a closed derivative comparison proves global rate optimality. The bundled checker is finite supporting verification rather than the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic scalar analysis with symmetric primal/dual curvature, bilinear coupling, no constraints or nonsmooth terms, exact block solves, and one common fixed step. Unequal curvatures or steps, multidimensional coupling spectra, stochastic sampling, multipliers, and inexact subproblems are outside the claim.
title: Sharp coupling frontier for sequential implicit proximal minimax on a bilinear saddle
